behaviours.title: Deposit of 100 increases balance
behaviours.then: result is { ok: true }, balance of 'A' is 100 and there is one 'deposit' entry of 100
behaviours.contrary_then: the deposit is rejected and the balance stays 0

behaviours.title: Deposit of 0 is rejected as invalid-amount
behaviours.then: result is { ok: false, reason: 'invalid-amount' } and no entry is recorded
behaviours.contrary_then: a zero deposit is accepted with ok true

behaviours.title: Negative deposit is rejected
behaviours.then: result is invalid-amount and balance stays 0
behaviours.contrary_then: the deposit is applied and the balance becomes -50

behaviours.title: NaN deposit is rejected
behaviours.then: result is invalid-amount
behaviours.contrary_then: the NaN deposit is accepted with ok true

behaviours.title: Duplicate deposit txnId is ignored but reported ok
behaviours.when: another 100 is deposited with the same txnId 't1'
behaviours.then: result is { ok: true }, balance stays 100 and there is still one entry
behaviours.contrary_then: the second deposit is applied and the balance becomes 200

behaviours.title: Invalid amount is checked before duplicate txnId
behaviours.then: result is { ok: false, reason: 'invalid-amount' }
behaviours.contrary_then: the duplicate txnId short-circuits and ok true is returned

behaviours.title: Amounts are rounded to cents, half away from zero
behaviours.then: balance is 0.13 and the entry amount is 0.13
behaviours.contrary_then: the amount is rounded half-to-even to 0.12

behaviours.title: Amount below half a cent rounds to 0 but is still accepted
behaviours.then: result is ok, balance is 0 and a deposit entry with amount 0 is recorded
behaviours.contrary_then: the deposit is rejected as invalid-amount

behaviours.title: Balance sums are not re-rounded to cents
behaviours.contrary_then: balance is exactly 0.3

behaviours.title: Unknown account has balance 0 and no entries
behaviours.when: balance and entries of 'X' are read
behaviours.then: balance is 0 and entries is []
behaviours.contrary_then: the balance of an unknown account is undefined

behaviours.title: Opening an existing account does not reset it
behaviours.then: balance stays 100 and the entry remains
behaviours.contrary_then: the balance resets to 0

behaviours.title: Entries returns a copy
behaviours.when: the array returned by entries is pushed to
behaviours.then: a later entries call still has 1 entry
behaviours.contrary_then: the ledger's own history is changed and has 2 entries

behaviours.title: Withdrawing the whole balance is allowed
behaviours.then: result ok, balance 0, and a 'withdrawal' entry of 100 is recorded
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal is rejected as insufficient-funds

behaviours.title: Withdrawing more than the balance is rejected
behaviours.then: result is insufficient-funds and balance stays 100
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal is accepted and the balance becomes -50

behaviours.title: Withdrawal amount is rounded before the funds check
behaviours.then: result ok and balance 0, because 100.001 is rounded to 100 first
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal is rejected as insufficient-funds

behaviours.title: Withdrawal of 0 is rejected
behaviours.then: result is invalid-amount
behaviours.contrary_then: the zero withdrawal is accepted with ok true

behaviours.title: Duplicate withdrawal txnId is ignored
behaviours.given: 'A' has 100 and has withdrawn 30 with txnId 'w1'
behaviours.then: result ok and balance stays 70
behaviours.contrary_then: the second withdrawal is applied and the balance becomes 40

behaviours.title: TxnIds are shared across deposits and withdrawals
behaviours.then: result ok but balance stays 100
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal executes and the balance becomes 50

behaviours.title: A rejected withdrawal does not use up its txnId
behaviours.given: 'A' has 100; a withdrawal of 150 with 'w1' was rejected; then 100 more was deposited
behaviours.then: result ok and balance becomes 50
behaviours.contrary_then: the retry is treated as a duplicate and the balance stays 200

behaviours.title: Withdrawing exactly the daily limit of 5000 is allowed
behaviours.then: result ok and balance 5000
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal is rejected as daily-limit

behaviours.title: Withdrawing 5000.01 at once exceeds the daily limit
behaviours.then: result is daily-limit and balance stays 10000
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal is accepted with ok true

behaviours.title: Daily limit adds up across withdrawals
behaviours.then: result is daily-limit and balance stays 5000
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal is accepted with ok true

behaviours.title: Daily limit is tracked per account
behaviours.given: 'A' and 'B' each have 6000, and 'A' has withdrawn 5000
behaviours.then: result ok and 'B' balance is 1000
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal is rejected as daily-limit because the limit is shared

behaviours.title: Insufficient funds is checked before the daily limit
behaviours.then: reason is insufficient-funds
behaviours.contrary_then: reason is daily-limit

behaviours.title: A withdrawal rejected for daily-limit does not use up allowance
behaviours.given: 'A' has 10000 and a 6000 withdrawal was rejected as daily-limit
behaviours.then: result ok and balance 5000
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal is rejected as daily-limit because the 6000 was counted

behaviours.title: Transfers do not count toward the daily withdrawal limit
behaviours.then: result ok and 'A' balance is 0
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal is rejected as daily-limit

behaviours.title: Withdrawal from an unknown account is insufficient-funds
behaviours.then: result is insufficient-funds and balance of 'X' is 0
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal is accepted and the balance becomes -10

behaviours.title: Transfer moves money and records an entry on each side
behaviours.when: 30 is transferred from 'A' to 'B' with txnId 't1'
behaviours.then: ok; A is 70, B is 30; A has a 'transfer-out' entry of 30 and B a 'transfer-in' entry of 30
behaviours.contrary_then: the transfer is not applied and A stays 100

behaviours.title: Transferring the full balance is allowed
behaviours.then: ok; A is 0 and B is 100
behaviours.contrary_then: the transfer is rejected as insufficient-funds

behaviours.title: Transfer of more than the balance is rejected
behaviours.then: result is insufficient-funds; A stays 100 and B stays 0
behaviours.contrary_then: the transfer is accepted with ok true

behaviours.title: Transfer of 0 is rejected
behaviours.then: result is invalid-amount
behaviours.contrary_then: the zero transfer is accepted with ok true

behaviours.title: Duplicate transfer txnId is ignored
behaviours.given: 'A' has 100 and has transferred 30 to 'B' with 't1'
behaviours.then: ok; A stays 70 and B stays 30
behaviours.contrary_then: the second transfer is applied: A becomes 40 and B 60

behaviours.title: Transfer to the same account leaves the balance unchanged but records two entries
behaviours.then: ok; balance stays 100; entries are deposit, transfer-out, transfer-in
behaviours.contrary_then: the balance ends at 50
